title: Get a permit to busk or perform in public places
what: Get the council's permit before busking or performing in streets or other public places.

laws.title: City of Melville Activities in Thoroughfares, Public Places and Trading Local Law 2014

sources.title: City of Melville Activities in Thoroughfares, Public Places and Trading Local Law 2014
sources.locator: cl 5.10, as made, Gazette No. 189, 2 Dec 2014
sources.quote: A person shall not perform in a public place without a valid permit.
